## Tlalusk (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
N Huge magical beast (cold)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., Perception +21, tremorsense 30 ft.  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 8, flat-footed 24 (+16 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 240 (16d10+80); fast healing 5  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +12, **Will** +7  
**Immune** cold; **SR** 22; **Weaknesses** vulnerable to fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft.  
**Melee** 2 gores +23 (2d8+8/19-20), 2 hooves +20 (1d8+4)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** bellowing blast, trample (DC 26, 2d8+12)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 26, **Dex** 11, **Con** 20, **Int** 5, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +28 (+30 bull rush); **CMD** 38 (40 vs. bull rush, 46 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Awesome Blow, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (gore), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (gore).*  
**Skills** Perception +21, Swim +17  
**Languages** Giant (cannot speak)  


**Ecology**


**Environment** cold plains  
**Organization** solitary, pair or herd (3-10)  
**Treasure** none  


**Special Abilities**


**Bellowing Blast (Ex)** As a standard action, a tlalusk can create powerful sonic vibrations in a 60 foot cone. All creatures in the area are stunned 1 for 1 round and deafened for 1 day. A successful DC 23 Fortitude save negates the stunning and reduces the deafness to 1 round. A tlalusk can use this ability every 1d4 rounds. This is a sonic effect, and the save DC is Constitution-based.  


**About**
